AUTHORING CONSTRAINTS AND GUIDANCE (from CORE-SPEC §9.17 + GRAPH-ALGEBRA-PLANNING §4/D4):
- node_inertias must all be > 0 (coercivity — the compactness replacement).
- avoid exact 0 weights: a zero coordinate silences its edges (a charge no flow tests).
- SIGNED weights are legal and native to J(w) — nothing disconnects. `contradicts` may
carry w < 0 (this formally reopens the §9.12 pure-affinity choice; the call is yours).
- order-unity scale recommended (overall scale only rescales time).
- SPREAD values across types: if all types get the same number this is the placeholder
again, and the shuffle-replica row stays weak. §9.12's lesson: margin = expressiveness
x structural difference. Note `related_to` covers 214/354 triples — its value sets the
bulk; the rare types (loyal_to, serves, depends_on) are where sharp values individuate.
- `derives_form_from` mirrors the graph's exact spelling (possible typo of
`derives_from`, 1 occurrence — renaming in the graph is number-neutral if wanted;
this table must match whatever the graph says).
